sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which technology allows a computer program to understand and respond to human voice commands, acting as a smart digital assistant?
Which type of puppet is typically controlled directly by the performer's fingers and hand moving inside a hollow fabric body?
Fill in the blank: A family health handbook usually contains essential medical records, emergency contacts, and a basic _______ kit checklist.
What is the primary vocational purpose of organizing a 'Kaushal Mela' in a school environment?
options: B) To showcase and celebrate students' vocational skills and crafts
C) To conduct annual sports events
D) To serve daily midday meals
questions.answer: B) To showcase and celebrate students' vocational skills and crafts

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: When giving a command to a voice-based AI assistant, the specific instruction or question asked by the user is called a ______.

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: What is the importance of maintaining an updated Family Health Handbook at home? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: It provides quick access to vital medical histories, allergy details, and emergency contact numbers, ensuring immediate and accurate medical responses during unexpected health crises.

questions.question_text: Define the role of a 'script' when performing a puppet show for a school audience. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A script acts as the foundational blueprint, guiding the puppeteers on dialogue delivery, character movements, voice modulation, and scene transitions to effectively narrate an engaging story.

questions.question_text: Describe two common tasks that a smart AI assistant can perform to help students in their daily routines. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An AI assistant can help students by quickly searching the internet for educational facts and setting daily alarm reminders for their study schedules and homework deadlines.

questions.question_text: As a group leader for your class puppet show, how would you divide the backstage responsibilities among your team members to ensure a smooth performance? [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, assign skilled voice actors to read the character dialogues clearly. Next, designate precise puppet handlers to control movements matching the speech. Finally, appoint a stage manager to arrange props and manage lighting, ensuring seamless transitions between different scenes.
